dialogue.content: For the 2001 Foxglove Classic, how much did the caterer want up front to hold the date?

The caterer, Delacroix & Sons Catering, wanted **$2,250 up front** to hold the date for the June 29, 2001 Foxglove Classic (165 boxed lunches, with the remaining $2,100 balance due on delivery). This is per email em-06347 dated June 13, 2001.
Perfect, thanks! And how much did the event end up raising?
The 2001 Foxglove Classic raised **$64,300** for the Bayou Literacy Fund, according to the post-event recap email (em-11462, July 2, 2001). That was well above the $50,000 goal.
